description: This file defines the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to handle declining a job offer for a candidate within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes annotations for OpenAPI documentation and a method to specify the resulting workflow state upon declining.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPI
classes.description: API class for handling candidate job offer declines within the recruitment process.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the action of declining a job offer.
